about: Step 1 of docs/STRAND_PLAN.md. Every tile of Prince's edge band, in order around him (T = along the outline, starting at the top of his head toward image-right = his left; E = extensions for the outer fringe and whiskers, with the nearest outline tile). Status flow: todo -> annotated -> self-checked -> owner-approved. Per-part status fields (e.g. 'outline') track each step separately.
